summary.text: Kory Haskins is the Democratic candidate for South Carolina House of Representatives District 63, facing Republican incumbent Jay Jordan in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Haskins was also the Democratic candidate for the same seat in 2024, when Jordan won the general election.

paragraphs.text: Kory Haskins was born in Durham, North Carolina, and attended Florence-Darlington Technical College.
His career experience includes working as a manager.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Haskins described himself as a 27-year-old father of one living in the Florence area who is new to politics.
Haskins ran for South Carolina House of Representatives District 63 in 2024 and lost the general election to Jordan.
In his survey responses, Haskins said he would want to pass laws giving teachers higher pay and greater benefits, and he also wrote about protecting the right to vote.
